name: Chiang Mai International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 18/36, 3,400 m long and 45 m wide (3,100 m available for landing on runway 18)

handling.v: ground handling by Thai Airways International, BAGS Ground Services, Chiang Mai Ground Handling Services, HS Aviation and Thai Ground Handling; fuel by PTT
handling.quote: Fuelling provide by PTT Public Company Limited.

slots.v: Level 3 (coordinated) airport: slots are coordinated by CAAT and non-scheduled flights must obtain a slot (business aviation applies with a General Aviation Clearance Request, GCR)
slots.quote: CNX/VTCC | Chiang Mai/ Chiang Mai International Airport | Coordination | CAAT; Applicants requesting approval for non-scheduled flight permission must obtain slots for Level 2 and Level 3 Airport.

permits.v: non-scheduled flights (including private flights) need a flight permit from CAAT's Flight Permit Division, applied for at least 3 business days ahead through the online system (FPOS)
permits.quote: The application must be submitted to the Flight Permit Division at least three (3) business days in advance

curfew.v: Winter 2026/27 (25 Oct 2026 - 27 Mar 2027): only emergency and medical flights 02:00-05:59 local (19:00-22:59 UTC); 00:00-00:59 local (17:00-17:59 UTC) limited to 4 flights (8 movements) a day and 01:00-01:59 local (18:00-18:59 UTC) to 2 flights (4 movements) a day, for noise
curfew.quote: To minimize noise impact on the surrounding community, CNX has implemented the following flight restrictions: During 17:00-17:59 UTC: 4 flights (8 movements) per day; During 18:00-18:59 UTC: 2 flights (4 movements) per day; During 19:00-22:59 UTC: Only emergency and medical flights will be accepted.

ppr.v: all flights must be coordinated with the airport in advance by the airline or handling agent; non-scheduled flights may stay on the ground no more than 4 hours (Winter 2026/27)
ppr.quote: Airlines and handling agents must coordinate with the airport in advance of all flights. ... The ground time for non-scheduled flights operating at CNX shall not exceed 4 hours.

max_aircraft.v: largest stands (bays 3-8) take up to code E aircraft; bays 9, 12, 15, 19, 20L, 20R up to code C
max_aircraft.quote: Up to A/C Code E (Bay 3 - 8); Up to A/C Code C (Bay 9, 12, 15, 19, 20L, 20R)

missing: curfew/ppr after 27 Mar 2027 (W26 capacity notice only; recheck S27 notice)
